Deportation Assistance

Support and guidance for immigration-related deportation matters.

If you've received a deportation order, Notice to Leave, or are facing an active immigration case, Airfair helps you understand your options and next steps.

Start Your Assessment Talk to Our Team

Facing a Deportation or Immigration Case?

Deportation proceedings and Bureau of Immigration cases can move quickly and carry serious consequences. Airfair helps foreign nationals understand their case status and coordinate the right next steps.

We work with clients to gather documentation, understand deadlines, and connect with appropriate legal support when needed.

Who Is This For?

This service is for foreign nationals who:

Have received a deportation order or Notice to Leave

Have an active or pending immigration case

Need help understanding their current visa status

Are facing an urgent deadline and need guidance quickly

How Airfair Can Help

We provide end-to-end assistance to make the process smoother for you.

Case Assessment

Clear review of your current immigration case and status.

Document Preparation

Assistance gathering and organizing the documents your case needs.

Legal Coordination

Coordination with appropriate legal counsel where needed.

Process Coordination

Help tracking deadlines and following up on your case.
